notes.title: SnowFighters 1.1.1 Update: Rush mode clear rewards added! Other bug fix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355185/47b6452dcf6177c9eb1620f9be8629b87e74bf96.png[/img]

[b]◆Add Rush mode clear rewards! [/b]
-Once you clear Rush mode, a fourth stage will be added to the stage select in normal mode!
-To check if you have cleared Rush mode, please check if the best clear time is recorded in the upper right corner of the Rush mode title screen.


[b]◆Other changes[/b].
-Fixed the behavior of Yukky's EX that sometimes became jerky.
-Tweaked the position of the Rush mode UI.
-Fixed a bug in the battle screen that slowed down the initial movement when using the keyboard.
-Fixed a bug that if the language was set to Japanese, Rush mode was cleared, and the language was -changed to English (or vice versa), the language was fixed to the language used when Rush mode was cleared.

notes.title: SnowFighters 1.1.0 Update: Single player challenge, Rush mode added!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355185/fa8c85f7d28f2385c29efbe6279353e3d709b7df.png[/img]

[b]◆Added Rush mode, a challenging element for one player! [/b]
- In this mode, six fighters battle it out in a total of 16 waves.
- The clear time is also recorded. Challenge your limits!

[b]◆Keyboard operation now supported! [/b]
- Keyboard input at the title screen switches to keyboard operation mode.
- If you want to play with two or more players, you need to prepare two or more controllers.
- To check the key configuration settings, click [F1] -> [Settings] -> [Operation Settings].

[b]◆You can now choose the strength of the CPU! [/b]
- The strength of the CPU can be selected on the character select screen of 2player and 4player.
- When you are operating the CPU cursor, press the Y button on the 1P controller.
- There are four levels of strength: 1, 2, 3, and 4.

[b]◆Other changes[/b].
- Strengthened Aicy's EX (tracking performance, shortened buildup before EX can be activated).
- Fixed a bug that sometimes snow ball did not build up to the max.
- Fixed the behavior of CPU Mizore's EX Weapon.

This will be the last major update, including additional features.
We will continue to work on minor bug fixes.

SnowFighters will continue to be developed for new platforms.

notes.title: SnowFighters1.0.4アップデート：遊びやすくなりました！
notes.notes:
[b]◆ You can now randomly select a character![/b]
-If you select the mark [？] icon, the character will be random.

[b]◆ A menu screen has been added after the battle![/b]
- Previously, after the fight, it automatically returned to the start.
    but now I can select the destination from the menu!
-You can choose from the following three items.
     -Fight again with the current settings, 
     -Return to the select screen, 
     -Return to the start screen.

[b]◆ CPU enhancement[/b]
-The CPU has become a little smarter! If you are confident in your skills, try fighting in a 1vs3 team battle.

[b]◆ Other updates[/b]
-The time limit can now be set in units of 15 seconds.
-It is set so that the cursor position is not initialized when returning to the select screen from the end menu.

notes.title: SnowFighers_1.0.3：Fixed minor bugs
notes.notes:
◆ Bug fix
-Fixed a bug where the timer stopped when a specific character was defeated.

◆ Specification change
-The stock that has not become a snowball will no longer disappear. (If you shoot a snowball when the stock is 2.66, the halfway stock disappears and it becomes 1.00, but this time it will be 1.66.)
-Adjusted the movement of CPU miso.

notes.title: SnowFighters1.0.3Update：Team battle mode added!
notes.notes:
[b]◆ You can now play team battles mode ! [/b]
-You can switch to team battle mode by pressing the select button on the 4-player battle screen.
-You can set your own team color (red, blue, green) with the X button.
-Attack does not hit the same team.
-At the end of the match, the team with the highest total HP will win.

[b]◆ Other specification changes[b]
-Changed not to track HP0 characters with Icy's EX move

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38355185/f83773beaf82ca8a651f88277b88dba2ebaf15ef.png[/img]

notes.title: SnowFighters1.0.2Update：CPU added to 4-player battle!
notes.notes:
[b]◆ You can now use the CPU in 4player mode! [/b]
-By default, the CPU is automatically set except for 1P.
-The CPU cursor can be operated with the 1P controller.
-When switching the CPU to the player, press the move key or button on each controller.
-When returning from the player to the CPU, press the Y button on each controller.


[b]◆ You can now choose the character color of the CPU! [/b]
-You can change the color of the CPU by pressing the L / R buttons on the 1P controller while controling the CPU cursor.


[b]◆ Fixed CPU behavior! [/b]
-Fixed a bug that caused strange movements on slopes
-Fixed a bug that stopped in place in walking motion
-Fixed a bug for each EX behavior
-Changed the specifications the EX weapon is not used immediately.
